title: Dates, numbers, and text patterns — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: A booking service schedules visits across time zones.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Which type represents a birthday without a time zone?
questions.explanation: A birthday is a calendar date.

questions.prompt: Which type identifies a point on the global timeline?
questions.explanation: Instant represents an absolute point in time.

questions.prompt: Why inject Clock into expiry logic?

options.text: To force the UTC timezone everywhere
To make time deterministic in tests

questions.explanation: Tests can fix or offset time without waiting.

questions.prompt: How do BigDecimal("1.0") and BigDecimal("1.00") compare with compareTo?
questions.explanation: compareTo ignores scale differences when the numerical values match.

questions.prompt: Which regex method requires the whole input to match?
questions.explanation: find searches for a subsequence; matches checks the whole input.

questions.prompt: What must be specified for a nonterminating decimal division when a rounded result is desired?

options.text: A scale or precision and rounding policy

questions.explanation: A rounding contract makes the finite result explicit.
Adding 10 days crosses the month boundary to November 1. 10 / 3 has a repeating decimal expansion. Scale 2 with HALF_UP produces 3.33.
